summary: Post-governance cross-platform verification on DGRHP (Windows/MSVC 14.44.35207, live rig via Tailscale): grepped the actual shipped exception_ptr class in <exception> directly. Confirms the Gate 8 finding was not libc++-specific but a general exception_ptr-move-semantics gap, and that std::exchange was the necessary fix, not a defensive extra. Full agent build (yuzu_agent_tests) + [send_executor]/[thread_pool] test run also performed on this rig - see run log for pass/fail.
